english.title: Use on a road a motor vehicle drawing a trailer when a secondary coupling device was not fitted to the trailer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), drawing a trailer to which regulation 15 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 applied, when not fitted with a device designed to stop the trailer automatically in the event of the separation of the main coupling between the vehicle and trailer whilst the trailer was in motion
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 86A(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(iii) There is a defence where a device to prevent the drawbar of the trailer touching the ground and providing some residual steering of the trailer is fitted in compliance with regulation 86A(2).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant used on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) drawing a trailer not fitted with a device designed to stop the trailer automatically in the event of the separation of the main coupling between the vehicle and trailer whilst the trailer was in motion.
